beginner.title: Get started with CATIA
beginner.outcome: You can: set up CATIA, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Interface and units
beginner.outcome: You can: set up projects correctly
beginner.practice: Start a project from the right template

beginner.title: Model or draw a first element
beginner.practice: Model or draw one element from a real project

intermediate.title: Drawings and documentation
intermediate.practice: Produce a drawing sheet ready to issue

intermediate.title: Coordinate and collaborate
intermediate.outcome: You can: work with other disciplines
intermediate.practice: Run a coordination review on a sample model

intermediate.title: Signature skills in CATIA
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make CATIA distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced CATIA
expert.outcome: You can: use CATIA's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Data and automation
expert.outcome: You can: use model data and automate

expert.title: Integrate CATIA into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect CATIA with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect CATIA to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use CATIA well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use CATIA" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
